concept: Globe Above a Node in an Open Ring
description: A circular globe with continent shapes sits directly above a smaller plain circle on the vertical centre line. A large open ring arcs around both, its gap facing downward.
A wide visor seen from the front, rounded along its top edge and dipping into a nose bridge at the centre of its lower edge. A small rounded strap connector projects from its right side.
A tall phone body with softly warped long sides and rounded corners, tilted slightly off vertical as if flexing. A short horizontal slot sits near the lower edge of its blank face.

A person with a round head and squared shoulders stands between two tall vertical posts. Each post carries a circular sensor node at mid height, and both posts join a horizontal base bar beneath the feet.
Two overlapping speech bubbles: the upper left one holds a Latin letter A with its tail pointing down-left, and the lower right one holds the Chinese character 文 with its tail pointing down-right.
A wide gamepad with flared grips curving down at both ends and an arched notch along its lower edge. A plus-shaped direction pad sits on the left and a single round button on the right.

A tall rounded escutcheon plate is divided by two horizontal bands near its top. A long lever handle extends to the right from a round hub low on the plate.
A pistol-grip drill with a rounded rear housing, a short motor section and a straight bit pointing right. Its angled grip ends in a thin bent support that turns into a flat foot at the bottom.

A quadcopter seen from the front has two T-shaped rotors on a wavy horizontal body. An arched gimbal hangs below the body holding a round camera lens with a vertical mark, flanked by short landing feet.
A wide rounded rectangular controller holds two round joystick dials side by side. A central antenna rises from its top edge between two pairs of curved signal arcs.
Two T-shaped propellers top a horizontal arm joining two tapered motor pods to a round central hub. A wide arched landing skid curves beneath the hub.
A wide rounded rectangle drawn with a dashed outline has a small solid capsule attached to the centre of its lower edge, interrupting the frame bottom line.

A tall empty rounded rectangle stands at the centre of a larger square drawn with a dashed rounded outline, with even space around it.
A wide rounded rectangular screen holds a centred tall empty rectangle. A short horizontal base line sits detached beneath the screen.
Three isometric cubes form a small pyramid: two side by side along the bottom and one resting on top between them. Each cube shows a top face and two side faces.

concept: Head with Field of View Lines
description: A head seen from above as a rounded oval with a small point at the crown and tiny ear bumps on each side. Two dashed sight lines angle up and outward from above the head toward the upper corners.

A long tilted gamepad with rounded ends rises from lower left to upper right, with a dip along its lower edge. A cross-shaped direction pad sits at the left end and two small dot buttons at the right.

An upright gamepad with a straight top, sloping sides and two grips spreading downward. A cable rises from the centre of its top edge; a plus pad sits on the left and a four-dot button cluster on the right.

A mechanical claw hangs at the upper left, its round hub held by two hinged jaws beneath two suspension rods. At the lower right a joystick on a trapezoid base sends two signal arcs from its ball top.
A bowl-shaped dish faces upward on two short legs. A round receiver on a short stalk rises from the dish centre, with two curved signal arcs above it.
A gamepad with a plus pad at the left and a single round button at the right sits between two pairs of curved vibration arcs, one pair on each side.
A rounded plus-shaped medical cross stands upright. Two curved alert arcs radiate from each upper side, framing its top arm symmetrically.
A round-bellied vessel with a narrow collar and a wavy water line across its middle. A short curled wisp of mist rises from the top of the collar.

A long capsule pod with a squared rear and a curved sloping nose faces right. A curved window line sweeps across the upper front, and two short horizontal marks sit near the rear.

A round robot vacuum in perspective shows an oval top panel, a cylindrical rim and a small half-round bumper at the front. Two short curved arcs rise from each upper side.

Two equal circles sit side by side across the upper half. A horizontal double-headed arrow spans beneath them, measuring the gap between them.
A head-and-shoulders figure wears a close-fitting cap and a wide visor across the eyes that dips at the nose bridge. The neck opens into rounded shoulders.

Four circular nodes sit at the corners of a diamond joined by straight links. Two Wi-Fi arcs sit inside the diamond near its centre.

A mechanical leg in side view: an angled thigh plate, a round knee joint, a slender shin strut and a flat foot at the bottom, stepping toward the lower right.
